# Meta Tools

Meta tools are system-level tools available in sessions. They handle tool discovery, execution, authentication, and sandboxing.

| Tool | Tags |
|------|------|
| [`COMPOSIO_GET_TOOL_SCHEMAS`](/toolkits/meta-tools/get_tool_schemas.md) | readOnlyHint |
| [`COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS`](/toolkits/meta-tools/manage_connections.md) | openWorldHint, destructiveHint |
| [`COMPOSIO_MULTI_EXECUTE_TOOL`](/toolkits/meta-tools/multi_execute_tool.md) | openWorldHint, destructiveHint, important |
| [`COMPOSIO_REMOTE_BASH_TOOL`](/toolkits/meta-tools/remote_bash_tool.md) | destructiveHint, openWorldHint |
| [`COMPOSIO_REMOTE_WORKBENCH`](/toolkits/meta-tools/remote_workbench.md) | destructiveHint, openWorldHint |
| [`COMPOSIO_SEARCH_TOOLS`](/toolkits/meta-tools/search_tools.md) | important, openWorldHint, readOnlyHint |
